using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.Tests.Cluster
{
    public class ClusterManagerTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void TryPrepareSlotsForMigration_LogsTrace_WhenCalledSuccessfully()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var clusterManager = new ClusterManagerForTest(loggerMock.Object);

            var slots = new HashSet<int> { 1, 2, 3 };
            string nodeId = "node1";

            // Setup the currentConfig mock to simulate valid state
            clusterManager.SetupCurrentConfigForMigration(nodeId);

            // Act
            var result = clusterManager.TryPrepareSlotsForMigration(slots, nodeId, out var errorMessage);

            // Assert
            Assert.True(result);
            Assert.True(errorMessage.IsEmpty);
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Trace,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("[Processed] SetSlot")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        // Helper subclass to expose and mock dependencies
        private class ClusterManagerForTest : ClusterManager
        {
            private ILogger _logger;

            public ClusterManagerForTest(ILogger logger)
            {
                this.logger = logger;
            }

            public void SetupCurrentConfigForMigration(string nodeId)
            {
                // We need to setup currentConfig and its methods to simulate the conditions
                // For simplicity, we override currentConfig with a test double
                currentConfig = new ClusterConfigForTest(nodeId);
            }

            // Expose currentConfig for testing
            public new ClusterConfigForTest currentConfig;

            // Override FlushConfig to do nothing
            protected override void FlushConfig() { }
        }

        // Minimal stub for ClusterConfig to simulate needed behavior
        private class ClusterConfigForTest
        {
            private readonly string _localNodeId;

            public ClusterConfigForTest(string localNodeId)
            {
                _localNodeId = localNodeId;
            }

            public int GetWorkerIdFromNodeId(string nodeId)
            {
                return nodeId == _localNodeId ? 1 : 2;
            }

            public string LocalNodeId => _localNodeId;

            public bool Equals(string other, StringComparison comparison)
            {
                return string.Equals(_localNodeId, other, comparison);
            }

            public ClusterConfigForTest UpdateMultiSlotState(HashSet<int> slots, int workerId, SlotState state)
            {
                return this;
            }

            public ClusterConfigForTest BumpLocalNodeConfigEpoch()
            {
                return this;
            }
        }

        // Dummy enum for SlotState
        private enum SlotState
        {
            STABLE,
            MIGRATING,
            OFFLINE
        }
    }
}
